sql:
SELECT
    p1.ProductName AS Product1,
    p2.ProductName AS Product2,
    count() AS TimesPurchasedTogether
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS a
JOIN retail.FactOnlineSales AS b
    ON a.SalesOrderNumber = b.SalesOrderNumber
    AND a.ProductKey < b.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p1 ON a.ProductKey = p1.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p2 ON b.ProductKey = p2.ProductKey
GROUP BY p1.ProductName, p2.ProductName
ORDER BY TimesPurchasedTogether DESC
LIMIT 25
